reason: Wrong vertical and wrong size: Tailscale is a Toronto-headquartered Series C zero-trust networking/VPN vendor (~238 employees, $274M raised, ~$778M valuation per CB Insights/Tracxn via Exa), not a US-based funded PC/console game studio of 20-150 entering full production; its live Infrastructure Engineer and Security Infrastructure Engineer postings are core product-engineering roles at an infrastructure company that sells this layer ('Design and build security controls across diverse layers (e.g., cloud platforms, OS, Kubernetes, networks, CI/CD)'), which is evidence of product depth rather than of senior engineers and a Tech Director being pulled off the game by unowned technical operations - so no live posting redescribes the milestone-confidence pain Ben Cole fixes, and at Series C scale with a full internal platform org there is no fractional technical-operations engagement here.
